name: AffrescoUI
description: The home of the apps: every example to open, and the apps the person made.

examples.why: Lists the example apps, and copies one to start an app of your own.

apps.why: Keeps the apps you make, in AffrescoUI in your home folder.

programs.affresco: Opens each app in a window of its own.

capabilities.assistant: Answers your questions about your apps, with the assistant you set up in Settings.
